name: UrbanPluvialFloodRiskToolbox
label: Urban Pluvial Flood Risk Toolbox
description: A modular and configurable Python toolbox for urban pluvial flood risk assessment. Implements the IPCC risk framework (Risk = Hazard x Exposure x Vulnerability) to produce PFRMA and PFRWB risk indices. Accepts inputs as RO-Crate FAIR Digital Objects or as individual files/zips. Outputs HEALPix aggregated risk maps on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

inputs.name: buildings
inputs.label: Buildings RO-Crate
inputs.description: RO-Crate containing building footprints with demographic attributes (FlatGeobuf or GeoPackage). Columns described via variableMeasured with I-ADOPT propertyID.

inputs.name: streets
inputs.label: Streets RO-Crate
inputs.description: RO-Crate containing street network outlines (FlatGeobuf or GeoPackage).

inputs.name: floodlevels
inputs.label: Flood Levels RO-Crate
inputs.description: RO-Crate containing flood extent polygons at multiple depth thresholds (Flood_30 through Flood_100).

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Configuration RO-Crate
inputs.description: RO-Crate containing the YAML configuration file with CRS, hazard parameters, TOPSIS weights, and visualization settings.

outputs.name: outputs
outputs.label: Output Workflow Run Crate
outputs.description: RO-Crate containing HEALPix risk maps (FlatGeobuf), vulnerability layers, publication maps, and provenance metadata.

author: FAIR2Adapt
citation: von Szombathely et al. (2025). Urban Pluvial Flood Risk Mapping: A High-Resolution Assessment for the City of Hamburg.
